u_013_native_5c265d16a31fcf094724.source: I'm working on to find and fetch your herbs.

u_013_native_8389f7903ef2b90893c3.source: Sorry, but I can't do it.

u_013_native_cf77175b1b300fb6cf62.source: You are welcome. You also had something for me, right?

u_013_native_7353bc8fe606f453da93.source: Well, if that's what you truly need you can have it.

u_013_native_f1c021b25ecf36f8e237.source: Why would I just hand out my gear to you?

u_013_native_5e00c4a7d4f0b769fd4d.source: No no, you won't get it from me.

u_013_native_3cb2f32e28e631f98fa4.source: There is a treasure you know and would tell me about?

u_013_native_87d165f9f1fda2a20400.source: What kind of spells are you talking about?

u_013_native_c3f47c006d01094e6ba0.source: You could teach me some {v1} skills?

u_013_native_68d26c95e8a38fef4f39.source: Sounds good to me. It is a deal.

u_013_native_f4fc56c13a774509d383.source: So let me give it to you...

u_013_native_5ace9a6962b57066d232.source: I would have appreciated to get something in return.

u_013_native_e4cd78f4038f7a13362e.source: Now I'm eager to have that {v1} lesson.

u_013_native_9b6e03aadbd09fa06e3f.source: Well, {v1} just spoke about a wolf that needs to be hunted down.

u_013_native_eaf7d9ee6ae29ab3a95e.source: Well, {v1} did warn me about a troublesome wolf.

u_013_native_59cc1e9713227b56c22f.source: Umm..what exactly are you talking about?

u_013_native_6f1f6ecba07e77fbc9b5.source: I have no time for bleeding-heart maidens. There's a wolf in the area in need of killing.

u_013_native_f3998fc2324940265f11.source: Well maybe you should tell me then.

u_013_native_19e34e32dc6db5fc40b7.source: You'd better have a good explanation to back up such a wild claim.

u_013_native_93f85917f544854cdeff.source: You're out of your mind, maiden. Now get out of my way.

u_013_native_60a62a1a624336154ebd.source: And did he find what he was looking for?

u_013_native_516afce9c2c8e82fd09c.source: Now this is interesting. Tell me more about this stranger.

u_013_native_726f6123cce65a9d7be9.source: I take it his charm worked on you too, hmm?

u_013_native_51b15b27ca4c4ad3d938.source: I see. Maybe not the smartest thing to do, huh?

u_013_native_44dfe6c3374a30b26cb7.source: Just how does this have anything to do with the wolf {v1} wants hunted down?

u_013_native_26e5bedc68042af9ed25.source: Right. But you just keep going on about your affair, and {v1} speaks of the wolf.

u_013_native_4fe487adc1b6e953b9af.source: Sometimes men need to roam the wilderness. Does anyone know about the affair?

u_013_native_cdd17233cf517fab1322.source: Are you ever going to get to the point?

u_013_native_124a9fd14bc95514a725.source: Obsession is a dangerous thing, but it still doesn't explain the wolf.

u_013_native_6b2ea72a20bcad5a365f.source: What do you think he's done?

u_013_native_fc0083a51c868f1622b4.source: Sounds like a far-fetched tale, but I've heard stranger things.

u_013_native_9fba308379c4caac4177.source: You must be crazy. Go back to your mushrooms, woman, and stop bothering me with this.

u_013_native_397aa8621c2870b965f5.source: Oh you're just being silly. Men can't turn into wolves. Stop bothering me with this.

u_013_native_6f4070b9aea154309939.source: How can one ever find a particular lone wolf in the wilderness?

u_013_native_17f22792d1379a13d68c.source: And you believe the curse can broken too?

u_013_native_89b2162da8719b580185.source: Sure. I will help you with this.

u_013_native_5a1b057cd69d0855d511.source: Nah. Take care of your own love troubles and leave me out of it.

u_013_native_39ed6383d105f2f0add9.source: Could you repeat how it all went?

u_013_native_62738eac4815c26b893b.source: Just try to hang on, I'm working hard to save him.

u_013_native_bc3cd49d5e11389a6339.source: I'm afraid there is nothing I can do to help you.

u_013_native_8f3c09985c0aaba9edeb.source: I really went after him and did as advised, but..huh..I'm still astounded by all this.

u_013_native_e2978985cd6ee2cf086c.source: Erm, I guess that is fine.

u_013_native_77718a9e43842c84e99b.source: My, that is exceptional. Thanks, and all the best for your future.

u_013_native_cc717ea69e9188144b4a.source: Yes, I've heard about a certain wolf from {v1}.

u_013_native_be91cfeace651993219d.source: Maybe, if I knew where it roams and why is it a troublesome one?

u_013_native_37c75b41e0fd1cfb3883.source: Nah, I'm not into wolf hunt right now.

u_013_native_b45a0927c8e6f08e8ab7.source: I'd like to hear more about this wolf?

u_013_native_5635a6960dd6f0e65ce8.source: I'm not afraid of no wolf.

u_013_native_d5236a28a77f11ec5b2a.source: I'm still curious about that wolf.

u_013_native_31e7318fad0e9a8c0e8a.source: {v1} told me all about this wolf you seem to know.

u_013_native_c81afc58b40ecef6434b.source: If that's all you can tell me it's a long shot to find it.

u_013_native_d8509c65ed1e163da32c.source: You know, {v1} told me about a certain lone wolf.

u_013_native_a61042d3581bb5b706bb.source: Could you repeat it all again?

u_013_native_056809792558fed5e7ef.source: Yes, and I'd like to help her out.

u_013_native_89ae03bfb5e3e1b777e6.source: Very well. Just tell me what to do?

u_013_native_53a837ab890c2f0b0a69.source: Oh my, I hope to never meet them.

u_013_native_4ecffd314f52a69d5c48.source: Thanks for the warning. I better travel safe then.

u_013_native_28078b22287dd54223d2.source: Hmm. Maybe I should learn more about them.

u_013_native_1ebc2b99c393aca6262f.source: And I don't want to get involved in this.

u_013_native_181441773508dac38819.source: It might be wise to keep guard around here.

u_013_native_428e0858e2cab0874f36.source: I take the warning and try to avoid ever meeting them.

u_013_native_4c31daa881dc3f6ca5f0.source: What if they will find their way right here?

u_013_native_71baa6606b9584f2245b.source: {v1} met them? So he saw these robbers?

u_013_native_f15cfb58bb24866f64f0.source: So you know who they are?

u_013_native_6377efd6f2486390fa2a.source: Somebody should do something about it.

u_013_native_8ee713046dd6e3a8a06b.source: Damn! Now I might go hunting these robbers.

u_013_native_aa561517f51ce84930b7.source: That brave one would be me. I will damn well find them and chase them away!

u_013_native_0b85adccb8ffa4563691.source: I just might go after them, if there is a reward?

u_013_native_af9ece3d0eb82661c7df.source: Don't look at me. I will not go after them.

u_013_native_6e1862240806c129a7da.source: I will do what it takes.

u_013_native_122c35e241ee7f95d9d2.source: If I can make it I expect to be rewarded.

u_013_native_9cf39000d223aef1be54.source: Fair enough. I will go after the robbers.

u_013_native_bdbe660885489cb74876.source: Your offer is accepted. I will go after the robbers.

u_013_native_e5a29f55f23e6bf117b0.source: Umm.. Now I don't think this robber hunt is for me after all.

u_013_native_5dc8575263cec883ca9a.source: I could talk about it again.

u_013_native_7983d29e019fca345926.source: And I have news for you. I did find the robbers.

u_013_native_4a20d2feb7ade22b544f.source: I'm sorry, but I have to give up on this.

u_013_native_feb104821356d2cce30e.source: I fought them hard and cut down at least some of them.

u_013_native_a6f4022aa3e558545c84.source: Let's just say that I made sure they won't be robbing no one no more.

u_013_native_fcdcf30ae3df61e1d735.source: I'm afraid they still just might be lurking in the woods....

u_013_native_7e2f2adbebb6bc64a5bf.source: I caused them some trouble, but I don't know if it was enough to make them leave for good.

u_013_native_97c41336dab59dbfad57.source: Do you know who they are?

u_013_native_24f80fb30de220350df0.source: Did you get to see who they are?

u_013_native_49fe172a06198d407232.source: I see you survived, so let's waste no more time. Just tell me where you met them?

u_013_native_ebe9c789e8a909963c1e.source: Can you tell me exactly where you met them?

u_013_native_6b39c9ca80fbcc732210.source: Maybe I could try to find them.

u_013_native_398e9e7b378d43808c4b.source: Okay. We better be careful around that area then.

u_013_native_904e4975af33a20c86d5.source: Very well. Let's see how it goes.

u_013_native_028be69eb83e704d3878.source: I see. You want me to travel with you?

u_013_native_e654acbafdc94567269f.source: Sorry, but I'm not travelling there now.

u_013_native_1598f721c77b914b6f2c.source: I think I can do that.

u_013_native_eda3ed917fa6080702a3.source: Sorry, but I don't think I can do that.

u_013_native_f22c585b650a6022f6ca.source: Agreed. I will escort you to {v1}.

u_013_native_41bf619ecd728a6cba63.source: Sorry, but thinking again I'll have to pass.

u_013_native_3ea00961ec6d0276f7c2.source: I need a day or two to prepare.

u_013_native_bdeed1ed658aa324e85f.source: I'm ready. Let us go now.

u_013_native_d29a8c289cead136666d.source: Thinking again, I have to leave you to manage on your own.

u_013_native_da44b4057d0881f82af4.source: Umm, and where did you want to go again?

u_013_native_dc9afce6fcb904d89e20.source: Don't worry, we are getting where you wanted.

u_013_native_25e1e5560e8bcabcb6b2.source: You're welcome. I'm glad to have helped.

u_013_native_d24a68bc9fb8ce2ed7e6.source: Oh, I'll leave you to rest then.

u_013_native_1a4bd235e3127cac3d5f.source: You must need healing herbs and sauna.

u_013_native_1e2618966fa8cae3575a.source: How did you get that wounded?

u_013_native_363f9f59cb84aca3d9bc.source: I don't want to bother you anyway.

u_013_native_a3a124f7ade5b9549a27.source: Good that you survived! Where was that?

u_013_native_46e2a05fe189ad30c00c.source: You saved your life but lost all of your items?

u_013_native_595aa912a4fdb23e82f0.source: It must have been one painful travel!

u_013_native_8cb15ef70908a2f84dd5.source: What did the locals say when you crawled here?

u_013_native_5a83d426d10c45591cc5.source: Hey, I can help you. I will seek that {v1} of yours.

u_013_native_5426871950c3ebfa6611.source: Precious enough to reward the one who finds it?

u_013_native_92e3d77d014024fb6372.source: I hope you get it back one day, though I can't help you.

u_013_native_2c6b4262939935835aeb.source: So tell me where was that shelter of yours?

u_013_native_40617374428a709fc99f.source: How about the items you had to leave?

u_013_native_0ae60b1417793acc532b.source: I hope you recover soon, but what exactly happened?

u_013_native_9f9a24b0b6160ed45f2c.source: Tell me again how was it?

u_013_native_cc14aec20d8557c47bf3.source: Sorry, but I just can not find it.

u_013_native_e8482b074d34eaab475d.source: Thank you for this. Well, farewell then.

u_013_native_19fe651f05adb99426c7.source: Good. You also mentioned compensating my efforts?

u_013_native_219a1bdfe66fb8a92642.source: Yes, I have done some bird trapping here.

u_013_native_8823c4260ecfc71637d0.source: Might be, but not all that much.

u_013_native_a4ea39f417ce1e3d42c5.source: Your snares remain empty? Well, a fox might snatch a bird from a trap.

u_013_native_0431ad0850aeeb640c14.source: No. It's just that this doesn't concern or interest me at all.

u_013_native_9c364a179e173d3e33c0.source: Now what exactly are you trying to say?

u_013_native_1310f53c62f717995eb6.source: Well, that's what you say, but I don't know.

u_013_native_9d106c0a4a0d384bd8ef.source: Now wait, you think there's a bird thief?

u_013_native_507e4b60792ea784d935.source: Oh, go on then. Tell me.

u_013_native_6b2ab7ec64fc6c3afb87.source: You keep losing every prey from every trap, huh?

u_013_native_6a1cf7c2e2c08c406077.source: I wish you better times in the future, but this is not my problem.

u_013_native_346208104a0658efa4f4.source: Any ideas who the thief might be?

u_013_native_5e19067da990dc274fb6.source: Now where can I find that trapping site of yours?

u_013_native_1aea50663227fcae37b4.source: I guess I have to believe what you say.

u_013_native_29f0798c6c7591669928.source: Couldn't you just set an ambush for the thief?

u_013_native_dfd425b9d36bb5360a05.source: I understand. But what can you do?

u_013_native_9f64c5299c58406aff25.source: What do you mean by righteous manner?

u_013_native_ea7ba7165c0e20c04001.source: Sounds troublesome. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.

u_013_native_b189d13090f00736d373.source: Blah. I would rather set an ambush for the thief.

u_013_native_c1cdaef467cb92ce9b82.source: Maybe so, but this doesn't concern me.

u_013_native_90246169a47164e2103a.source: I might try to help you...but would you compensate my efforts somehow?

u_013_native_5d15f996387e4313939b.source: Sounds complicated. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.

u_013_native_dcc49c533046a2c535ee.source: Very well. I will do my best.

u_013_native_140d80c7135bf914eb7b.source: {v1} did tell me how to make a bird thief confess.

u_013_native_4aed5c96dde34196dd31.source: I'm still working to get it solved.

u_013_native_469ba01c8087b42d9f19.source: I'm sorry, but I can't do it.

u_013_native_e9e32b96a51427c0bf8f.source: Yes, have I performed the spell.

u_013_native_9b999a78186f9c8fdd4f.source: So we'll wait and hope that the thief eventually comes forward.

u_013_native_253768a20053ea647849.source: Oh! Now who was it, and what did he say?

u_013_native_c3dc3323dd877647e5ea.source: Very good! I guess my work is done here.

u_013_native_5cce8b8032ea1fac65d0.source: Oh! Thank you. I'll try to be wise with it.

u_013_native_6c447c85d4c42a203c5d.source: Well, it's about birds..and thieves...in general.

u_013_native_9e832ff7673ab922ded3.source: If there was say a bird thief, are there spells to reveal him?

u_013_native_9ad78406c7605d81e593.source: Umm..you want me to bring you a whole bird?

u_013_native_5d03cd2d4418ab9b3f70.source: A bird hunter? I've forgotten how was it.

u_013_native_94bae28f92222c4c9247.source: Thank you. I'm grateful for this advice.

u_013_native_9aa6d7f4ecf1957b5923.source: I did what you asked, now how about that spell?

u_013_native_d6f0687fce19eb744e8c.source: Well, I'm just wondering what urged you to confess.

u_013_native_6d70e7cbe201431c649e.source: Well, it was actually I who revealed you.

u_013_native_e2c080a97533fdcf84d5.source: Somebody indeed made a spell. It was me.

u_013_native_af6d46d79a079416a5cf.source: You got what you deserved. Stealing somebody's catch is outrageous.

u_013_native_c2d868ff7a61e8ff0a1a.source: I guess all is well then.

u_013_native_57c19a7e27fc9069eb95.source: Well, I thought you might need it more than I do.

u_013_native_bf12520e80660baa03a5.source: Let's see, where are you heading?

u_013_native_768d9007e61d4d1a1de0.source: How come you got lost like that?

u_013_native_81d25d436779df53c155.source: I'm afraid I can't help you.

u_013_native_65e596f5265f2e17a414.source: Let's hope not, but unfortunately I can't take care of you.

u_013_native_8634222b92cd72103ab3.source: Quite an incident! Just tell me where to take you now?

u_013_native_7da66cc1f198acacaabd.source: Phew! You better walk with me, then.

u_013_native_cb062206d7063068a265.source: Even so, I have to leave you to manage on your own.

u_013_native_54c8056bf1bb5228ec9e.source: Just what has happened to you?

u_013_native_beb02ffca05b6d5c6476.source: Unfortunately I don't think I can do that.

u_013_native_662fe664d227c2c8bace.source: Don't worry, we are getting there.

u_013_native_cc3fa010671129ed9e54.source: Very well. I'm glad to have helped.

u_013_native_3e4e9eaf4e6ae10f18db.source: Heh, how come you say so?

u_013_native_adba14dabc30e5e2aa7a.source: Sorry, but I have duties of my own.

u_013_native_3baa87bdf7a44c2dc1d4.source: I see. Just say if there's something I could help you with?

u_013_native_c566185f491151dbe7b8.source: Sounds like you need a helping hand.

u_013_native_58f8d8825222ff219a25.source: Let's see. To whom should I deliver your message?

u_013_native_eab3c6775eead9bd5d65.source: Sorry, but I don't think so.

u_013_native_6f0dded54420e2191f3d.source: I think I can do that. And what is the message to be delivered?

u_013_native_5059486b8357486c0e49.source: Sorry, but I think I'll pass this task after all.

u_013_native_02559a4434008f7f09d8.source: What that little reward might be?

u_013_native_adcd6f4a19789df6ec62.source: Understood. I will go deliver the message.

u_013_native_ad89e9b3d21b54d39f87.source: And you compensate my efforts somehow, right?

u_013_native_fd2cd8f9a7a0fdf3335f.source: Oh well, no problem. I will deliver the message.

u_013_native_e0fdbce463d47eb7a421.source: Maybe, but it depends on that reward.

u_013_native_81f1c866355e04d7cb2d.source: Hmm, I'm not convinced. I won't deliver the message.

u_013_native_8d7b698242a9c82f08ce.source: Umm, what was I supposed to do?

u_013_native_a4128e840e2d608e8127.source: No, I haven't got it just yet.

u_013_native_1c3f9c5bb5b071457c5d.source: Sorry, but I have to give this up.

u_013_native_3780988757bb580dca82.source: it's best to prepare the offerings

u_013_native_a5ed255c42673cc6f5c8.source: the knot needs to be untied

u_013_native_708d14016e7e2b6ef31f.source: He asked me to tell you that {v1}.

u_013_native_390c13fc03ae43bfb146.source: there were two sons in a dream

u_013_native_62f9e56b87fbc035631f.source: He said I should bring your reply back to him.

u_013_native_22d0f66dcd4d6906c700.source: Thanks. I will go deliver your reply back to {v1}.

u_013_native_b80895a9bea89b871ef8.source: This gets sillier and sillier! What is this about?

u_013_native_f1ca5a8f3283d76d01a0.source: Aha, and what has made you think so?

u_013_native_5ced4d6090d19d9b0b37.source: I don't think concerns me at all.

u_013_native_a3ac925ff4a80f7032b3.source: I see, and will gladly listen to you.

u_013_native_6885d576924aba6ba224.source: Well, I don't know if that's actually necessary.

u_013_native_9cfbba41b9f7e3a70f90.source: How do people get to meet them?

u_013_native_6a2c9d9d3f1644a41367.source: Might they appear for me as well?

u_013_native_03ac7ced11a595d281be.source: So, tell me all about it?

u_013_native_da3bfb5a6ea90808d2b3.source: Hmm, what is this water folk like?

u_013_native_5fc030548014103b139e.source: You think I should meet them?

u_013_native_b845fb09592960f91d68.source: Firstly, what do they look like?

u_013_native_1504981ec9777f5293f2.source: And then, what should I know and how to behave?

u_013_native_eeb24c4bd723ea756350.source: And what does this water folk actually look like?

u_013_native_9847dc6c21f1d2730fa7.source: I see. Anything else I should know about?

u_013_native_de50851fac3b3d95076a.source: Very well. We'll see how it goes.

u_013_native_d20022e14b936566c049.source: Tell me again about the water folk?

u_013_native_64ad5682f30bf303f914.source: I think I have met the spirit of the water!

u_013_native_7c75e11d490049887ff2.source: I see, and I am all ears.

u_013_native_534940729a0930021972.source: Very well. Thank you for your guidance.

u_013_native_749ea6825289855f66a3.source: Who you might be talking about?

u_013_native_fbae63de55c850bc9b0b.source: What's it to you where I roam?

u_013_native_ad06fb0300a844ca5999.source: Hmpf. I do not need your help.

u_013_native_042122328db60f5c220a.source: I don't think it is that important.

u_013_native_a9c2be6db5107238b8a0.source: How do people get to meet these spirits?

u_013_native_9097a71873aeae7e5c7f.source: Would it possible for me to meet the spirit of forest?

u_013_native_99d0b4683ceffa71ab18.source: Yes, I certainly would like to learn all there is to it.

u_013_native_b14eb2325ed613cb053e.source: Oh, and what kind of sight this spirit of the forest might be?

u_013_native_598dfdd13e657e30cfaa.source: You think I should meet the spirit of the forest?

u_013_native_9e23d3c7a9b10b74a4ff.source: Firstly, how does this spirit look like, if he arrives?

u_013_native_37920e15f18bda67c631.source: And then, what should I do or say to behave right?

u_013_native_2902db42f955e85d3a45.source: I wonder how is the appearance of the forest spirit then?

u_013_native_c5d58f6ecadcedd74a0a.source: Could you please tell me again about the spirit of the forest?

u_013_native_9ba0446ea299b7b656a7.source: You were right! I did meet the spirit of the forest!

u_013_native_b5f2c08b3e449de646cf.source: That sure is interesting. I'm listening.

u_013_native_85175c233e0d35b794c7.source: What keeps you busy? I mean, is there anything I could help with?

u_013_native_2318290056409eff2425.source: Ah, sorry for interrupting, just go ahead with your busy chores.

u_013_native_c715fcf8d4e6bb449453.source: I see. Just let me know if there is something simple I could do on my own.

u_013_native_d9f15f7f97c3df57f554.source: Ah, yes. So, if there is a task you could give me, I'd be glad to help.

u_013_native_fc0a871c910e1f0ba9b8.source: Sounds like you might need a helping hand.

u_013_native_b37bcaa3ea7f9ad8ec05.source: Sounds like something I can do. Where do you want me to drop the stones?

u_013_native_e153a69f2c91a9c0c4be.source: Good, I'll go collect the branches. Where do you want me to pile them?

u_013_native_559c359d6ed2ddb8daaf.source: That sure is a simple kind of work, but I'm sorry I can't do it just now.

u_013_native_a6154a4d9d8e099602d7.source: I'll do it, but I expect to be paid too.

u_013_native_5e7217f269cc344db852.source: Sounds good, I'll do my best.

u_013_native_fcad31eed22e81f0ce56.source: And you pay for this work, right?

u_013_native_45cc9fa6773f9385528e.source: I guess I'm not done just yet.

u_013_native_9ce6abd5031592f0c917.source: Sorry, but I have to give it up.

u_013_native_eaf6f47b7e22fde177b3.source: Forest maids, huh? I wouldn't know.

u_013_native_ba7f153fbc75d427df6f.source: What is it about this time of the year?

u_013_native_6d01063cebe19d0434b2.source: You just dream on, old man.

u_013_native_595c3b11957916ef447e.source: Just what kind of creatures are you talking about?

u_013_native_c9a7d22336320997ecf2.source: Maids who come at campfires? For what?

u_013_native_4946fbf512c82c9d3ffb.source: Silly maids. I always build campfires of my own.

u_013_native_497bc4bb6c32f2fab46f.source: I see, but what is that they come or appear for?

u_013_native_9fd7b91086b3cbc6857f.source: Hmm... What is that they come or appear for?

u_013_native_15e7d0ca1f6209f3a413.source: Sure. In the eyes and minds of men at least.

u_013_native_91d8c1e17247419bacc3.source: Something special about these days then?

u_013_native_e06ba6c742a1509ce190.source: And you have met forest maids yourself?

u_013_native_c6de38b6213d7bdb0a1d.source: Oh! You don't seem to be talking about quite ordinary maids at all?

u_013_native_0b85713c7908e4079723.source: Oh, you have actually met them?

u_013_native_4b205283f1fc8baa96f1.source: What is it like, their company?

u_013_native_4ab80968847b790b7812.source: Whatever they are, they sound like generous maids.

u_013_native_827b62b70edb486e115b.source: Don't be shy. I'm all ears.

u_013_native_d4d3ad941548b908f47b.source: You are telling me to have actually met a forest maid?

u_013_native_8b20e861ca9e9c4ea3ef.source: And how was the company of a forest maid like?

u_013_native_35918e38bc5a14af6af8.source: Oh, now I'd like to meet a forest maid myself too.

u_013_native_4673356bc55509e7c0ac.source: Yeah, right, but I'm a maid myself too, so...

u_013_native_8e9b69c3f8588deb87d3.source: So have you heard about sightings of them?

u_013_native_4a6b8199ce0f0fb8b8b9.source: Tell me again about the forest maids?

u_013_native_d9c83c9087c1fb246557.source: And I think I have seen one!

u_013_native_7161743cc3df8d9c1a49.source: Have you ever met forest maids?

u_013_native_3a51ff4868e236de1766.source: I wonder if {v1} really met one?

u_013_native_f7da10bb74f77b1aae4a.source: Could you tell me more about forest maids?

u_013_native_93ceca9a676965abdf40.source: What is it like to meet them?

u_013_native_39b509b6507df95913ff.source: You also mentioned about attracting them?

u_013_native_3614769193b3519dae7b.source: I see. Good to know this.

u_013_native_47f3d6fed9b5d7f8d11c.source: What do you think happened then?

u_013_native_4fb941c34644044c2010.source: How can you be so sure?

u_013_native_5777633f9ab91cb89b6b.source: Be that as it may, but I want to hear it all from you.

u_013_native_46aaaacc499423ff4b9c.source: Oh, but it wasn't her who told me.

u_013_native_6c95f68241ee974a6f32.source: Umm, about whom are you talking?

u_013_native_8e5e384044a3394ff816.source: I see, but now I just want to hear what happened from you.

u_013_native_c28ed26a81013a5958e6.source: Very well. Nice that you told me.

u_013_native_1ae3b5c54ee00832a60f.source: I might try to help you with that {v1}.

u_013_native_aafad79bdc9ed29c5c6b.source: How did you manage to lose a {v1} just like that?

u_013_native_b2d1aa4f88a6ce514aa5.source: I'm not too eager to run after stray animals.

u_013_native_703da7035285913c7ca4.source: First tell me what happened and I'll think about it.

u_013_native_f899bc9884d1dd3c2bd8.source: Sorry, but I'm really of no use right now.

u_013_native_91fe6b91894def62e3f7.source: If that's so is there anything left to be done at all?

u_013_native_d1fda7e9d0aafa0472e1.source: Any details about where in the forest it seemed to disappear?

u_013_native_b8e64e8263743b5ce810.source: You lost it somewhere in the forest?

u_013_native_93b79caff211a126404a.source: If that's the case what there is to be done about it?

u_013_native_de911d180b86efe6bc40.source: Maybe it can be found, if I only knew where to search?

u_013_native_12be61a751cde658fb0a.source: Umm, what {v1} speaks of confuses me.

u_013_native_0cffe7ba055be42d90b2.source: I would still like to help if I can.

u_013_native_c6dea2e3e04c2bed4bac.source: Sorry, but I have to give up already. If a sage can't help then neither can I.

u_013_native_18a82bc88ad09c222fd6.source: Sounds fair. I'll see what I can do.

u_013_native_fe381e73c66145a7c590.source: Nah, I don't think that's worth the trouble.

u_013_native_8a0bc5e2c1191391f6f1.source: Very well. I'll do my best.

u_013_native_ea5a58e376d22ac0fde8.source: Could you refresh my memory about that {v1}?

u_013_native_14235074720b6ca1a807.source: Not yet, but I'm trying my best.

u_013_native_a764bc2da5945fcc6ddf.source: Sorry, but I have to give up on this.

u_013_native_82b26c00524cbf3ff542.source: Thank you. I am grateful for this.

u_013_native_ef51580e266f3ecc4f28.source: Binding the forest? That's beyond my knowledge.

u_013_native_9d005103d9e33e1ec8fb.source: The spirits are angry you say?

u_013_native_f83fdf3d02c1275d1be6.source: I was thinking if I could help to find this {v1}.

u_013_native_7fe6db92811b342aaab6.source: Aren't there other means to get the {v1} back?

u_013_native_c5e550d028b210bc995b.source: Now is there anything else to be done?

u_013_native_3176f35d82ecf4679146.source: And what is it that you have done?

u_013_native_55b02eb671e9e1b59974.source: Here I am if I'm of any use.

u_013_native_0372d328ccf852448e33.source: I think I'm up to the task.

u_013_native_3ef0532edf97611521b9.source: Sorry, but I think I'm not the right kind.

u_013_native_8085e564000b5ae043a9.source: Tell me what to do and I'll do it.

u_013_native_af949baf8f982c7eb71a.source: I feel this is not for me, after all.

u_013_native_a1c07cfe7036d7719cf3.source: You seem quite sad. What is wrong?

u_013_native_820fdf7b811ac686316b.source: Sorry for disturbing you. Maybe I'd better go now.

u_013_native_ada805bec4dd61fb9e04.source: Would you like to tell me your tale of woe?

u_013_native_46adb36635290ac113b3.source: Sorry to hear that, but I'm not interested in your sorrows.

u_013_native_2275313e9164a80b2a04.source: Oh. If I catch fish I'll give some to you.

u_013_native_b5315937dea06bbde793.source: It must have been a very special punt to you.

u_013_native_2ea936f6a33eddc406c1.source: Would you buy a punt if I trade you one?

u_013_native_9faec2e983c774871a78.source: You really should get yourself a new punt.

u_013_native_8d0235ffbbcb96baf23e.source: You really must have liked that punt.

u_013_native_8b4e30990cc6005ac434.source: Oh! I'm interested in what you are saying.

u_013_native_715fa0555d07f2028d9f.source: Now how can you ever find a new punt like that?

u_013_native_a0210880f5cb8d2b0308.source: I hope you find a helping hand. It's not me, though.

u_013_native_c6dee30d3087ac99692c.source: Very well. I think I can manage.

u_013_native_b59a7539a10d7421c854.source: What sort of reward you had in mind?

u_013_native_2c0baba795bf9a4d7280.source: Sorry, sounds like too much work to me.

u_013_native_1a226a1d8077edb1a78a.source: Very well. I will back with your new punt.

u_013_native_5b70d351436fba44eea9.source: Good! Now I'm eager to hear your fishing advices.

u_013_native_3904cb3b34957395f015.source: Good! I'm happy to have helped.

u_013_native_9462f5df478c09409da3.source: How long does it take? I promised to take the punt to him.

u_013_native_9fdabad1fd83e7930d84.source: "I'd like to hear what {v1} has to say."

u_013_native_71a5fb8ed7b49dae41df.source: "Nah, I've changed my mind. Now give my items back."

u_013_native_539f2fa9edee5ff4252b.source: "I will give you what need. Here..."

u_013_native_21eb75bcd557d1a3d911.source: "Forget about it. I've changed my mind."

u_013_native_4e67228066e30ad807a2.source: "Yes, I know. How about more distant settlements?"

u_013_native_a11afe245a2063b3d692.source: "What do you want as a payment?"

u_013_native_737248331a82088bce2b.source: "No! You have to fight for them!"

u_013_native_8471ef4f86c883f8c285.source: "Never! I will fight back to the last drop of my blood!"

u_013_native_5bb3b2d3dde811247420.source: "Hmpf. I surrender. Take what you want."

u_013_native_57153f0d22a6d2fece56.source: "No. If you want my stuff you have to fight for it."

u_013_native_85bb8a2fc3960f59ef33.source: "Well, it depends on what you want?"

u_013_native_6d2ead10dfa3451f740d.source: "I surrender. Take what you want, just spare my life."

u_013_native_d846c605cb16f43c6fa6.source: "Hah! Why would I give you my stuff?!"

u_013_native_5fdee287a779f11728e9.source: "Oh, take what you want, but don't hurt me."

u_013_native_a26e20c757f0ca8bdfee.source: "I'm very sorry, but I still need some metalworks."

u_013_native_644f4ad54dc4a8e1b57a.source: No, no, no. I didn't mean that.

u_013_native_002d949c1610fb62de64.source: Yes, I am. This is a robbery!

u_013_native_2c5ce45ae6b8136a14b6.source: "I'm sure of it. You can go now."

u_013_native_f53adfb152d56bcb784f.source: "Well, I think I changed my mind. Please stay."

u_013_native_6248427c67d5b9f54a5b.source: "Let's see what I can trade from you."

u_013_native_498aa27fca06310e3ba6.source: "Very well. Let's settle for the items I've picked."

u_013_native_6f48c531d0c304c2891c.source: Start the trade again from the start

u_013_native_fec857372341fbbb1133.source: "What of my items you'd prefer in this trade?"

u_013_native_10b02d3453ff3c23e9d6.source: "This doesn't please me. It's no deal."

u_013_native_a4b174b936312ea7d9f0.source: "Remind me about what I owe you?"

u_013_native_2dd313e6305bca3940ae.source: "I am not able to pay. Take what is yours."

u_013_native_569e41960138ded2acb9.source: Oh? Could you repeat that if you really mean it.

u_389_doc_6c32b1b0fd51b49b6674.source:
Cloth is a base material for crafting various garments. Cloth can be woven from linen, hemp, nettle or wool yarn and it is produced in a standard width of two feet. Cloth lengths vary from a few feet to a maximum length of around 10 feet. As cloth is woven on an upright loom, often indoors, there is a limit to its practical length.
Cultivated plant-fibre cloth is the most valuable type of cloth. Linen being the most expensive, followed by hemp. Wool cloth is more affordable and thus more commonly used, especially for making outer garments, than plant-fibre-based cloth. Wool cloth is roughly half the price of linen cloth. This is because of the much higher workload required to produce plant-fibre cloth. Nettle cloth is the least expensive, but nevertheless a practical and commonly used alternative to more luxurious linen.
All the eastern and western cultures, except for the islanders, can produce cloth, and depending on the exact culture, lengths of linen, hemp, nettle or wool cloth are sometimes available for trade in their villages.

u_389_doc_d22ba3957615bc3f80eb.source:
Clothes can be made of wide variety of materials with variying techniques. Materials used in clothing in the UnReal World can be separated into two groups.
Those originating from the vegetable kingdom are: CLOTH and BIRCH-BARK and those originating from the animal kingdom are: WOOL, LEATHER and FUR


Metal armours are not usually worn nor made among the local cultures of The UnReal World. They are brought in with foreign traders and warriors. In general metal armours are very rare, and even the foreign warriors need to rely mostly on fur and leather for protection. Helms, cowls and pieces for spot protection are far more common than body armours. Wealthy villages of DriikilΣiset, Sartolaiset, Koivulaiset and ReemilΣiset may very rarely have some traded metal armours available. Metal armour materials and techniques are: MAIL, IRON and LAMELLAR

u_389_doc_6dc0950e4a5d0d1334ae.source:
Birch-bark is usually peeled and removed from a tree in long strips which are then wound to a ball for storage. This kind of balls are called 'Sommelo' in UnReal language. Alternatively, birch-bark can be also removed in sheets.
When birch-bark is used in clothing its use is restricted to birch-bark shoes, birch-bark caps and small pieces for spot protection or to be used as ornaments etc. This is because finished birch-bark equipment isn't very elastic and feels coarse against the skin. Birch-bark garments give some protection against edge and tear attacks but for point or blunt strikes they are somewhat useless.
More commonly birch-bark is used in making of various artifacts, for example boxes, baskets, ropes or net floats. In the wilderness situations it can be also used for preparing simple cooking vessels such as a birch-bark pot.

u_389_doc_dd0650da999183d925fd.source: Nalbinding is a technique for making clothes from wool yarn using a needle to form and connect stitches in a specific sequence, creating a continuous textile. The yarn is used in lengths of a few metres, with the needle held in one hand and the thumb of the other hand used to regulate the size of the stitches. The method is time-consuming, but creates elastic and warm clothes. It is most commonly used to produce rather small but important wintertime garments such as nalbound socks, cowls and mittens.

u_389_doc_f350692a38fb97415048.source:
The local people of The UnReal World dress themselves in a variety of fur, leather, and cloth garments. In addition, there is a selection of woollen garments made using the nalbinding technique, as well as some garments made of birch bark.
The choice of materials for people's clothing depends on their availability and the culture in question, and the same type of clothing can often be made from a wide range of materials, each adding different properties to the finished item.

Clothing names are quite self-explanatory, but here you can find details of some commonly encountered garments:

Head: CAP, COWL, VEIL (women), FUR HOOD

Upper body: SHIRT, UNDERSHIRT, TUNIC (men), UNDERGARMENT (women), DRESS (women), CLOAK

Lower body: LEGGINGS, TROUSERS (men), APRON (women)

Feet: FOOTRAGS, NALBOUND SOCKS, NALBOUND KNEE SOCKS, SHOES, BOOTS

Hands: MITTENS

u_389_doc_12f24ffaae0ede9e1fe0.source:
Boots are long-shafted footwear extending below the knee. They are made of either leather or fur, depending on the intended use and weather conditions. Fur boots are for winter, providing both warmth and protection. The fur is left on the outside, making them highly insulating and warm in freezing weather.
Leather boots can be used year-round but require warm socks or trousers during the coldest weather. Both fur and leather boots often have a curved toe, which helps keep ski straps in place.

u_389_doc_1deb8afbdea5957850ec.source: Shoes provide protection and warmth for the foot and make walking in rugged terrain more feasible. Shoes do not extend above the ankle, as opposed to boots, which do. All the shoes wear out in use and the most durable ones are made of leather. Even so, they need to replace them every other year if used extensively. Walking barefooted, or using simple birch-bark shoes, is therefore very common during the summertime in to prolong the working life of the precious leather shoes.

u_389_doc_3d24f5b1cb52c46ca712.source: A simple belt made of leather, usually worn with thicker outer garments or when carrying a sword, small axe, or other heavy item attached to the belt.

u_389_doc_d282ecc19986fae9d73a.source: Shoes woven from strips of birch-bark to protect the feet. They are commonly worn in summer, thereby helping to preserve more valuable shoes and boots from wear and tear. If used extensively on a daily basis, birch-bark shoes will wear out in a few weeks, so several pairs are needed to last through the summer.

u_389_doc_d988113f9f7987577817.source: Tunic is a common long-sleeved, thigh-length outer garment worn by men. To keep their wearers warm, tunics are often made of wool cloth and worn over an undershirt. In the coldest wintertime, tunics may be worn with an overcoat over them. Small brooches are commonly used to hold the front of a tunic closed.

u_389_doc_68c089fdad0d166494b1.source:
Shirts can be either short or long-sleeved, and the length of the hem also varies. Cloth shirts are always short-sleeved, except for the undershirt, which is long-sleeved and has a longer hem. A cloth shirt is sometimes also worn over other outer long-sleeved layers of clothing, such as a tunic.
Shirts made of leather and fur are always long-sleeved. A leather shirt is worn instead of a cloth shirt when additional protection is needed.

u_389_doc_6236c9de28c3b90c7698.source:
Both men and women wear an undershirt as the bottom layer of clothing under thicker and coarser outer garments. Men typically wear a tunic, while women wear a dress over the undershirt, with additional layers of clothing added as necessary. However, in summertime, when outer garments are hardly needed, an undershirt is sometimes worn on its own to cover the upper body.
An undershirt is preferably made of soft linen, nettle or hemp cloth that feels comfortable against the skin, has long sleeves, and usually extends to mid-thigh. Instead of an undershirt, women may also wear an undergarment that extends down to the calves.

u_389_doc_40c907646ff93dbe8dac.source:
A cloak is considered an essential part of both women's and men's everyday clothing, whether in the village or out in the wilderness, especially in colder weather. In winter, a fur cloak can be a practical choice, but otherwise cloaks are typically made from a large rectangular piece of cloth with the edges sewn to prevent fraying.
Cloaks can be worn in many ways and fastened with a brooch or by tying them. Women's cloaks sometimes feature a variety of decorations and long fringes.

u_389_doc_201241eff7c2499bed15.source: A veil is a women's head covering made from a rectangular piece of cloth. The edges of the cloth are sewn to prevent fraying and are sometimes also decorated with ornamental patterns. The veil is worn by simply tying it or fastening it with a brooch.

u_389_doc_9701c07bbc67d7e800eb.source: An apron is part of a woman's everyday attire, and its purpose is to protect other garments while working. Decorated aprons are also worn on important special occasions. It's made from a rectangular piece of cloth with the edges sewn to prevent fraying. The apron is fastened around the waist with a cord threaded through it and usually extends down to the knees.

u_389_doc_5d7014e5f8e150cf7f01.source: An undergarment is a long, dress-like undershirt worn by women as the bottom layer of clothing. It has long sleeves and extends down to the calves, and is made of soft linen, nettle or hemp fabric that feels comfortable against the skin. A dress is typically worn over the undergarment, with additional layers of clothing added as needed depending on the season.

u_389_doc_8ad7cefa27574ef24f72.source: Dress refers to a garment worn as an outer layer as part of a woman's attire, typically made from wool or linen. The dress is quite simply a body-length rectangular piece of cloth that wraps around its wearer, pinned with brooches at both shoulders and allowed to drape down around the body. The dress remains open down the other side, or is only partially sewn, forming a tube-like section in the middle. The top part of the dress is often folded to create an over-fold at the wearer's chest. The dress is usually worn over either an undershirt or undergarment, and during the cold season, additional layers of clothing are added on top of the dress.

u_389_doc_edf2949ce50361af0fd7.source: A fur hood is a warm and protective covering for the whole head. It is made loose enough to cover the wearer's face as well, which is essential in cold and windy weather. Fur offers protection from many types of impact, so it can also be used as light head armour.

u_389_doc_87df2d182e1b0007c4c2.source: A cap is a headwear that comes in various shapes and is designed to cover the head. It can be made from a variety of materials depending on its intended use. In winter, it is common to wear a fur cap or a woollen nalbound cap for warmth. A leather cap or birch-bark cap may be worn in less demanding weather when head coverage is desired.

u_389_doc_8ef52f1eaf53276d9d1e.source: A cowl is a piece of clothing that covers the head and neck, used mainly for warmth and protection from the elements. A woollen nalbound cowl is a typical wintertime garment worn by local cultures, but it can be also sewn from cloth if only a thin and light cover is desired. Foreign warriors may also wear mail armour cowls for protection in battle. Sometimes they are made long enough to cover also the shoulders.

u_389_doc_00f49783ef236e8945ab.source: The combination of a breastplate and backplate covering the thorax and abdomen. Local people may rarely use cuirasses made of thick leather as simple armour in battle, but the most common type is the lamellar cuirass worn by the Njerpezit.

u_389_doc_46c8b9f0bd6e08c4a05b.source: A piece of armour for the legs. Its primary purpose is to protect the shinbone from attack. The shinbone lies very close to the skin and is therefore extremely vulnerable to just about any kind of attack. Furthermore, a serious injury on the shin may result in that leg being rendered useless, greatly hampering one's ability to maneuver in any way. Working shin guards can easily be made from thick leather, but foreign warriors also use lamellar ones.

u_389_doc_36d2d0a9d06c2769c9ca.source: Separate pieces of clothing to protect legs; actually the hips, groin, thighs, knees and calves. Leggings can be made from cloth, leather, or fur, depending on the level of protection desired. They are tied on with leather thongs or cords. When worn with pair of trousers leggings give extra protection and warmth. Sometimes leggings are also worn instead of trousers, as they are much easier to make than trousers, which require a great deal of cutting and sewing.

u_389_doc_352485a5b7d53d032f9c.source: Extending up to the knee, a woollen nalbound knee socks are excellent for keeping the entire legs warm in cold weather. There are also short nalbound socks for warming only the feet when the legs can be sufficiently covered by a warm outer garment.

u_389_doc_661779900e428a1f2478.source: Short nalbound woollen socks that reach up to the ankles, designed to protect the wearer's feet especially during the wintertime. When more complete leg coverage is desired, there are also nalbound knee socks.

u_389_doc_c10f84bb880b2f625b85.source: Socks are made by nalbinding technique from wool yarn. They come in two lengths, common nalbound socks and nalbound knee socks.

u_389_doc_06bc63b847d228784648.source: A glove without separate fingers to protect and warm the wearer's hands. Mittens are an essential wintertime garment and are commonly made of fur or wool yarn by nalbinding.

u_389_doc_a1ad6456f2a9b2ff4743.source: A long coat which extends to the knee and has long sleeves to cover the whole arms. Overcoats are made of wool cloth or fur and most commonly used in winter when warmth is more important. They are made loose enough to allow several layers of clothing to be worn underneath.

u_389_doc_9bbcf24a9e085a3738ce.source: A piece of men's clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate section for each leg. As trousers are relatively complex and demanding garment to make, leggings may be used as a substitute when necessary. Instead of cloth, trousers can also be made of leather, and leather trousers are practical for uses where durability and protection are required.

u_389_doc_197c8b2fc96493e26acc.source: Footrags are rectangular pieces of cloth wrapped around the feet for protection or warmth. They are a very simple substitute for socks, and no sewing is required to make them.

u_389_doc_9993c04d9fed31fa2f83.source:
Yarn is made either by spinning plant fibres or twisting sinew fibres into long strands. It is commonly used for sewing clothes, but has many other uses too. For example in crafting of a loop snare or line of a fishing rod.
There is also wool yarn which can be used be to make nalbound clothes. For spinning yarn by yourself refer to your TEXTILECRAFT skill.

u_389_item_d4a88330c75875ca721b.source: Some yarn, cord, rope, and so on. You can craft various types of tying equipment by yourself.

u_389_item_8175a3841e0d105ea058.source: A length of any type of cloth. Cloth is available for trade among certain cultures.

u_389_item_66a51649b5765a5e760b.source: Bandages can be cut from clothing, including leather and fur, or from a length of cloth.

g_80f30527c5a4a09a8537.source: Many unpleasant rumors about %s have come to our attention.

g_824a9e1274d462d518b9.source: One of them commanded me to hand over my belongings and others joked about robbing at {qst_v84} getting boringly easy.

g_833885f0d95e18557f3a.source: Sometimes men need to roam the wilderness. Does anyone know about the affair?|TALKLINE 9:{qst_v33} does, and that's why he acted as he did.

g_835256b2c005d4938672.source: They say there is {contents} to be found.

g_85a8465186bebca7555d.source: The point is {qst_v33}'s obsession about me and what he's willing to do about it.

g_85f109ab208c59de4bb1.source: Would you help me then? If so, I can offer {reward_1}.

g_87377880996353cd5183.source: I have this lucky {item} which I now want to give you.

g_8746af29c4015e845e27.source: I would have appreciated to get something in return.

g_8776dccac3c8b4582d29.source: Well, okay. I must say I'm partially responsible for this misfortune.

g_87780f5ee79eb2da107b.source: Aren't there other means to get the {qst_ArgList} back?|TALKLINE 5:You seem willing to help, but first you need to learn something.

g_8924f0674953171b4488.source: Agreed. I will escort you to {qst_ArgList}.

g_892d5cee400e01628c0e.source: No no, you won't get it from me.|REJECT:Keep it then. Thinking again, they don't seem that good to me after all.

g_8956019757c8f5da32a2.source: I'll lay low now and hope that you'll learn to do what it takes. Oh, and visit my last trapping site if you need to examine the traces of theft.

g_89a377471256ecbb2aae.source: But if I think about it, I guess it might have been {qst_v71}.

g_8d8004855f634f1d0183.source: So he says. And he wants it hunted down.

g_8d853169c07d0e96d45b.source: Hey, I can help you. I will seek that {qst_ArgList} of yours.

g_9385fe5f29d7ead02822.source: Right. But you just keep going on about your affair, and {qst_v33} speaks of the wolf.

g_94b32a133adb2a483c8b.source: Sorry, but I have to give up already. If a sage can't help then neither can I.|REJECT:Hmm. Maybe so. We will continue the search on our own then.

g_95528ee56eab033dcf80.source: I see. Just say if there's something I could help you with?|TALKLINE 3:Hmmm... Thinking of it, I might have a task for you.

g_958b0c2e6011ae0b9298.source: Aren't there other means to get the {qst_ArgList} back?

g_96ee69d0f59fd382900b.source: The log you should bring to {npc_name} needs to be carved out of not just any tree.

g_98279c6fdc985f96720e.source: Nobody can find it until it's freed.

g_9abfa549721fc3b18b4b.source: Sounds like you might need a helping hand.|TALKLINE 1:Or maybe even two.

g_9ae2322ba5c3bc46fc43.source: First tell me what happened and I'll think about it.

g_9b24d9e3a447c5517acb.source: You know, {npc_name} told me about a certain lone wolf.|TALKLINE 5

g_9c0a7a4ec76101275c21.source: Unpleasant news about %s have reached us.

g_9c2f960c848046b4bfe8.source: {npc_name} did tell me how to make a bird thief confess.|TALKLINE 19:That is excellent news!

g_9dfddc9fe81720082b4d.source: And who is {qst_v16}?|TALKLINE 12:The other one here besides me who has seen forest maids.

g_9fd9b3982eb2e6df64d8.source: Precious enough to reward the one who finds it?

g_a1ae76627131a894d8ac.source: Keep it then. Thinking again, they don't seem that good to me after all.

g_a396fef0fc162f1b2281.source: The only precious item that was left there is my {qst_ArgList}. My father gave it to me when I was a kid, and it's the only thing left of my family.

g_a557791d0085d4db41fd.source: Say, would it be possible for you to give me {qst_Buffer}, huh?

g_a67bd3dc9cf97aadd2a6.source: What's it to you where I roam?|TALKLINE 1:To me? Sigh.

g_a83901c06090aefdbd7f.source: At least a moment ago {part} was wandering around here

g_aa629588f298f300b2c8.source: If I get it back, you'll get rewarded with {reward_1}.

g_ad85f011e5ff90ff4306.source: Hold on, I'm just coming to that part!

g_adb1eed5699fc91eae4f.source: It was {npc_name} who told me.|TALKLINE 2:Oh! Alright.

g_b024ee9fb11f3dfda272.source: Only then I realized having faced the danger and looking at these rumoured robbers with my own eyes. One of them commanded me to hand over my belongings and others joked about robbing at {qst_v84} getting boringly easy.

g_b0b9dea3d366d09274d4.source: Oh, and have a little reward for the trouble.

g_b2a2260754a8125a5432.source: My equipment was at the shelter, but afraid of the {qst_v109} still around I didn't dare to go get them and left while still conscious. I was bleeding bad, but determined to survive and crawled my way to this village.

g_b2f3a56de00345993d8b.source: My equipment was at the shelter, but afraid of the {qst_v109} still around I didn't dare to go get them and left while still conscious.

g_b3d9194659d8071f02d2.source: Well, if that's what you truly need you can have it.|TALKLINE 3

g_b512f0c4a41b7c0ce76f.source: {qst_v92} met them? So he saw these robbers?

g_b53e6d9e4394b2b4055e.source: I was thinking if I could help to find this {qst_ArgList}.

g_b67c26d03c53e873eaf3.source: You know, {npc_name} told me about a certain lone wolf.

g_b74b67aa01ed10fef55b.source: Well, {qst_v33} just spoke about a wolf that needs to be hunted down.

g_b766e1f30dbac17cbcf2.source: Heh, how come you say so?

g_b81d5a514880ae2aee80.source: is telling you women's tales. I'm not going to speak more about this with you, {player_identity}. Why don't you just leave.

g_b8d52621442383670fb2.source: And what is it that you have done?

g_bf6b4644300d8176988b.source: Sorry, but I'm really of no use right now.|REJECT:If you say so then I won't bother you with this any longer.

g_bffaef1f74e9d6abd594.source: Well, it depends.|TALKLINE 6:Depends on the reward? Well...

g_c0a5dbb88c975f0b33be.source: I've found footprints and feathers by the triggered snares, but never any bloodscapes to indicate the birds being taken by animals. If you need to see it for yourself you can visit my last trapping site.

g_c0d4f183a2b2311a9713.source: Are you ever going to get to the point?

g_c1d4d40c08dfa5a1d30c.source: Would you care to barter for the goods you've gotten?

g_c2326d557274cfba284a.source: Umm, what {npc_name} speaks of confuses me.|TALKLINE 6:Well, he can tell you more about it. Anyway...

g_c348e0a4dcede64af983.source: During the night the temperature will be {night_forecast}

g_c4bba508940816b95ac1.source: Thanks. I will go deliver your reply back to {qst_v44}.|EXIT:Good. You do that.

g_c59644afdef02b402d68.source: Sorry, but I have duties of my own.|REJECT:I understand. Bye then.

g_c6c68f13772b51bb25e1.source: See, wolves are wolves even if there was a human spirit inside them. I can't help you more than this. Good luck.

g_c8d399bcb667a8df4e99.source: During the day the temperature will be {day_forecast}

g_c96e87e5f0583efcdec7.source: I see. Just say if there's something I could help you with?

g_c9d8f47d6e75314877b5.source: No no, you won't get it from me.

g_cad58ef175667563fdec.source: {qst_v29}. He lives nearby in a village {producer_49A580}.

g_cc2fbe97874d5eb945fd.source: Who you might be talking about?

g_cd852d16af0b9aeb4c4c.source: Now I'm eager to have that {part} lesson.

g_cd903691f4b57a32751d.source: You seem willing to help, but first you need to learn something.

g_d1bc2887b6e071499a7e.source: Who you might be talking about?|TALKLINE 2:The spirits, silly. Who else?

g_d3be827815ff067e4f15.source: My equipment was at the shelter, but afraid of the {qst_v109} still around I didn't dare to go get them and left while still conscious.

g_d3f1442303a23bccd85b.source: We've been warned about %s at this area.

g_d45b61b5c48c87f798cd.source: Could you refresh my memory about that {qst_ArgList}?|TALKLINE 3:Your memory went missing? Well, so did our {qst_ArgList2}.

g_d4d29abcba668b4937ea.source: I need all my gear, {player_identity}, and if you do also then so be it.

g_d82f3e8facecd9505e83.source: Ah, sorry for interrupting, just go ahead with your busy chores.|TALKLINE 1:Yeah. I guess I have to.

g_dabd8be7f14a7bf3207e.source: You're welcome. I'm glad to have helped.

g_db9f4f2674a8ecd8995e.source: I'm sure they aren't stupid to have stayed there for a long time. Tresspassers have brought us rumors from every corner of {qst_v84} so they are on the move a lot.

g_dc660f166e972c1293e0.source: I remember building my shelter at {qst_v61}.

g_dec1b770633f8a6c9d24.source: Or a pair of extra legs, actually.

g_e17ce73541d0aafe0035.source: Your bravery will appreciated by {qst_v91} people!

g_e1ab4aa59e2d64451425.source: Wolves just don't fancy bread that much so you need to go close and trick it to eat. Or if you dare, throw the bread right into its mouth. However you can get it to eat, it's all good from there on.

g_e33d70090431c1e2ac99.source: Thanks, {player}. This might come in handy.

g_e36a8f8c742c0a744f9b.source: What keeps you busy? I mean, is there anything I could help with?

g_e3a10a9f7c84815c1cc0.source: {npc_name} did tell me how to make a bird thief confess.

g_e44f15eeded68f17bac8.source: Let's see. To whom should I deliver your message?|TALKLINE 4

g_e46483a133c77d2ceb87.source: They move around {qst_v84} and can be lurking anywhere out there now. Sneaky forest robbers! Every sighting of them seems to come from a bit different location. First it was trespassing wanderers who told us having been robbed on their way, but now our {qst_v92} has met them too!

g_e4f07e875329b0b45091.source: See, {qst_ArgList} already promised to make me a new punt if I just bring him a proper aspen log to be carved. But I'm too old to cut down a tree and to haul a log.

g_e5e96be319cde4f69eb1.source: Let's see. To whom should I deliver your message?

g_e737e4e3136e3eed61f7.source: And what is it that you have done?|TALKLINE 2:The spell, of course.

g_e7536622be64de65fca4.source: If you really are up to confronting them you should talk to {qst_v85} about it. These ruthless bandits need to be chased away from our lands - and soon!

g_ea2764df2ae80409c3be.source: Aha, and what has made you think so?|TALKLINE 1:I've been watching you.

g_ea9fd6e9564432817837.source: Why would I just hand out my gear to you?|TALKLINE 1:I just thought we would have helped each others.

g_eb12c5ddb69c4fb869ba.source: Thank you. I am grateful for this.

g_eb4a6117f209ad32e69e.source: We have received many news about %s.

g_ebcd94c645e5cc4cc3f4.source: Hey, I can help you. I will seek that {qst_ArgList} of yours.

g_ec3f23312904a75f5b70.source: I just thought we would have helped each others.

g_ec85f093e1108b293ebe.source: How did you manage to lose a {qst_ArgList} just like that?

g_ecd34952660958e36522.source: That brave one would be me. I will damn well find them and chase them away!|TALKLINE 8:Your bravery will appreciated by {qst_v91} people!

g_ed22905d31f89527545b.source: Hey, I can help you. I will seek that {qst_ArgList} of yours.|TALKLINE 6:That would be a noble deed!

g_ed44b7818dbb1173103c.source: If I get it back, you'll get rewarded with {reward_1}.

g_edf731530292bd7d206d.source: I see. You want me to travel with you?

g_f0977d66b1b73305668e.source: You'll find me here. I won't be venturing back into the wilderness anytime soon.

g_f0ed1328fe53a53fa478.source: Unfortunately I need all my gear, but maybe I have something for you too.

g_f4daca7b7631e927ecc6.source: Right. But you just keep going on about your affair, and {qst_v33} speaks of the wolf.|TALKLINE 9:Hold on, I'm just coming to that part!

g_f6c84cb1560368910f7d.source: It's the usual sight there, and it wasn't the first time at all. Now I don't have the nerve to continue trapping until the thief is revealed.

g_f76cadf241907bbad997.source: I was thinking if I could help to find this {qst_ArgList}.|TALKLINE 5:Nobody can find it until it's freed.

g_f89565946c16685468d0.source: Early in the morning, as I was gathering branches for a fire, I suddenly stumbled into an angry {qst_v109}. I tried to disengage, but the {qst_v1092} kept following me, and eventually we fought. I had nothing but my knife to wield as I had left everything else by the shelter.

g_f982bd30ff394bbd9cce.source: Sorry, but I'm really of no use right now.

g_fa126d24e57d4f270ace.source: That would be a noble deed!

g_fa23326d203b9ccac3bb.source: How is it going, have you found the {qst_ArgList} yet?

g_fc6d357c6a470f0f6a19.source: That brave one would be me. I will damn well find them and chase them away!

g_fec7d52c76eaf6bc959e.source: Very well. Just tell me what to do?|TALKLINE 3
